powod.NO_TEXTURES: {geo} geometry, but no textures to compare
powod.SAME_MODEL_SAME_TEX: same model, same textures ({a}/{na} and {b}/{nb} textures in common)
powod.SAME_MODEL_SUBSET: same model; one texture set is contained in the other ({a}/{na} and {b}/{nb} textures in common)
powod.SAME_MODEL_PARTIAL: same model, textures partly in common ({a}/{na} and {b}/{nb} textures in common)
powod.SAME_MODEL_OTHER_TEX: same model, but different textures — a retexture, not a duplicate ({a}/{na} and {b}/{nb} textures in common)
powod.SIMILAR_MODEL_SAME_TEX: model only SIMILAR (distance {dist}), but same textures ({a}/{na} and {b}/{nb} textures in common)
powod.SIMILAR_MODEL_PARTIAL: similar model (distance {dist}), textures partly in common ({a}/{na} and {b}/{nb} textures in common)
